_note: Every number is a frame. The rally: the opponent serves at the first hit, then it alternates opp/you with the gap between hits shrinking by 7% each time (22 frames down to 4). Your last hit is never returned: the ball bounces on his half and hits him in the face at `bonk`. After that it bounces itself out. Shared by TableTennisShort.tsx and scripts/build-tabletennis-audio.py.
